Not sure what people are doing wrong to have so many "doesn't work!" reviews.

As of July 2026 this works fine in Chrome on MacOS. I wanted a URL copy shortcut that mimics what's available in browsers like Arc or Zen. Cmd+Shift+C to copy the current URL works just fine the majority of the time. Once in a blue moon the standard inspect element sidebar pops open. But the desired behavior is consistent enough for this to get a 5 star from me.

Seems to be more mature, and working more reliably now mid 2026.  Lots of play time for sure.
I think a permission issue exists when the extension does not works as intended. Check that "allow user scripts" is enabled.  Also, when starting and making test, be sure to exit from Chrome in the menu not by using the "x", then go to a simple static html web page to to make test and remember to refresh the simple web page each time you make a change and want to test.  Also at installation, try to use the extension button on that simple web page you make your test at least a few times.
